# Generative AI Policy

To maintain the quality, security, and integrity of this project, we enforce strict guidelines regarding the use of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and similar LLMs).

Please review these rules before opening issues or submitting code.

## Contribution Guidelines

### 1. Feature Requests & Pull Requests
* **Core Team & Trusted Contributors:** Members of the core team or long-term, well-known contributors may use AI assistance at their discretion, provided all code is thoroughly tested and verified.
* **Untrusted & External Developers:** If you are a new contributor, external developer, or not well known by the core team, **you are strictly prohibited from using AI to generate Feature Requests or Pull Requests.**
    * *Exception:* You may use AI assistance *only* on issues or pull requests explicitly tagged with the **"Help Wanted"** label.

### 2. Descriptions, Comments, and Discussions
* **No AI Text in Communications:** Under no circumstances should generative AI be used to write Pull Request descriptions, issue descriptions, or comment responses.
* **Human-to-Human Clarity:** We value precise, human written communication. AI-generated text often introduces unnecessary verbosity ("slop") and fails to capture the true context of human intent.

## Enforcement & Non-Compliance

All external contributions are carefully audited. If a submission is found to violate this policy (e.g., automated code patterns on non-tagged issues, or clearly AI-generated PR descriptions):
1. The Issue or Pull Request will be immediately closed without review.
2. Repeat offenses may result in a permanent ban from contributing to this organization.

---
*Thank you for helping us keep this codebase maintainable and human-driven!*
